QuestInfo.name: To the Excavation Site!
QuestInfo.0: There's an announcement posted on the Relic Excavation Association Board in camp...
QuestInfo.1: - Announcement - \n\nA bloodthirsty band of skeletons has appeared in the Excavation Site and they are stirring up a ruckus! Any brave adventurer who helps eliminate these undead beasts will be rewarded. Please see #rShawn#k in the #bRelic Excavation Camp#k for details.
QuestInfo.2: After seeing the announcement, you went to see Shawn.

0.0: - Announcement - \n\nA bloodthirsty band of skeletons has appeared in the Excavation Site and they are stirring up a ruckus! Any brave adventurer who helps eliminate these undead beasts will be rewarded. Please see #rShawn#k in the #bRelic Excavation Camp#k for details.

no.0: We're always looking for brave heroes eager for adventure!

1.0: Darned moving fossils... Huh? What are you doing here?
1.1: Ah, you must be here because of the announcement I posted! Excellent! I could really use your help!

yes.0: Things aren't going so well, my friend. I can hardly raise my pick to an ancient relic without getting jumped by a monster!
yes.1: We can't delay the excavation any longer! We NEED your help! Please, patrol the Excavation Sites and eliminate any monsters that you find.
